04The poems

Poems

The reading order follows the exhibit’s argument. Iqbal’s two poems move from pride in a united India toward a shared Islamic identity. Faiz, Pritam, and Gulzar then bring perspectives shaped by their experiences of Partition and its aftermath. Auden closes the sequence with a British perspective. The timeline places the poems alongside historical events using their composition and publication dates.
